name: xiphactinus_fossil
description: The Sternberg 'fish-within-a-fish' fossil slab (1952): grey-cream stone with the cream bones of a 4 m Xiphactinus facing right (fanged underbite skull, vertebral column, long ribs, neural spines, long pectoral fin rays, forked tail) and a smaller complete tan Gillicus skeleton lying inside its ribcage, head pointing back (swallowed head-first), centred at local (0, 0). Anchor centre, ~900x325.
